text: MCP: discover_local_graphs — list every .bowman graph on this machine with name, repoId, idea counts, last activity and root aims
description:
From a Claude Code session 2026-11-23 wiring ~/dev graphs into Felix's life graph. OBSERVED: to find the graphs the agent ran `find ~/dev -name .bowman` and a Python script reading every meta.json and idea file, because the backend's discoverLocalProjects (3ec89f4a) is UI-only. 31 .bowman folders were found, 12 with content; several had no repoId and some had no meta.json at all (3dream, bowman, avonx/artwork), so they can't be linked.

Proposal: an MCP tool over discoverLocalProjects with configurable roots (default ~/dev), returning per graph: path, meta name, repoId (or 'none'), idea/open counts, last status change or commit date, whether it's already registered from the calling graph, and the graph's portable mission line (see the suggest_repo_links idea). Optionally initialize missing repoId/meta. Root aim titles only if Felix sees that as compatible with the black-box rule (e81b11c3): before linking, it's discovery, not a link.

Refuted if agents don't use it, or discovery from the UI is enough.

status.comment: Proposed by Claude 2026-11-23 from a cross-repo session (see description).
